t: Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him, was asked about the Quraysh, when he replied : As for Banu Makhzum they are the blossoms of the Quraysh. It is delightful to talk to their men and to marry their women. As for Bamu Abd shams, they are far-sighted and cautious about all that is hidden from them. As for ourselves (Banu Hashim) we spend whatever we get and are very generous in offering ourselves in death. Consequently, those people are more mumerous, more contriving and more ugly while we are more eloquent, well-wishing and handsome
